test_title: PYST 36: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Better late than never

options.text: It is better to reach late than never arrive
It is bad to read late
It is not good to reach late
It is better not to attend if late

solution:
Here the correct answer is** It is better to reach late than never arrive.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom** "better late than never"** means that** it is better to do something even if it is late, rather than not doing it at all.**

 
 
• **Example: **I finally submitted my college application
